name: GDELT DOC 2.0 API

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Contains the search query. Supports keyword and keyphrase searches, OR statements, and various advanced operators. Must be URL-encoded. Valid operators include: "" (exact phrase), (a OR b), -, domain:, domainis:, ImageFaceTone:, ImageNumFaces:, ImageOCRMeta:, ImageTag:, ImageWebCount:, ImageWebTag:, Near:, Repeat:, SourceCountry:, SourceLang:, Theme:, Tone:, ToneAbs. Values must be URL-encoded. Example: %22islamic%20state%22

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Specifies the output mode. Valid values: ArtList, ArtGallery, ImageCollage, ImageCollageInfo, ImageGallery, ImageCollageShare, TimelineVol, TimelineVolRaw, TimelineVolInfo, TimelineTone, TimelineLang, TimelineSourceCountry, ToneChart, WordCloudImageTags, WordCloudImageWebTags

parameters.name: TIMELINESMOOTH
parameters.description: Only available in timeline modes. Performs moving window smoothing over the specified number of time steps, up to a maximum of 30. Must be an integer between 1 and 30.

parameters.name: maxrecords
parameters.description: Only applies to ArticleList and ImageCollage modes. Specifies the maximum number of records to return. Default is 75. Can be increased up to 250. Must be an integer between 75 and 250.

parameters.name: timespan
parameters.description: Specifies the time span for the search. Default is 3 months. Valid formats: [number]min, [number]h, [number]hours, [number]d, [number]days, [number]w, [number]weeks, [number]m, [number]months. Example: 1week, 3d, 2h

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Controls the file format of the results. Valid values: HTML (default), CSV, RSS, RSSArchive, JSON, JSONP, JSONFeed. Note: RSS and RSSArchive are only available in ArticleList mode.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Specifies how results should be sorted. Valid values: DateDesc (most recent first), DateAsc (oldest first), ToneDesc (most positive first), ToneAsc (most negative first), HybridRel (default, combines textual relevance and outlet popularity). Note: HybridRel is the default new relevance sorting mode for content published after 2018-09-16 00:01:00.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Used for JSONP output. Specifies the name of the callback function. If not present, defaults to 'callback'. Must be a valid JavaScript identifier.

parameters.name: STARTDATETIME
parameters.description: Specifies the precise start date/time in YYYYMMDDHHMMSS format. Only articles published after this date/time will be considered. Must be within the last 3 months. If not specified, the API will search from 3 months ago.

parameters.name: ENDDATETIME
parameters.description: Specifies the precise end date/time in YYYYMMDDHHMMSS format. Only articles published before this date/time will be considered. Must be within the last 3 months. If not specified, the API will search through the present time.

parameters.name: TRANS
parameters.description: Only available in ArticleList mode with HTML output. Embeds a machine translation widget. Value must be 'googtrans' to enable Google Translate Widget.

parameters.name: TIMEZOOM
parameters.description: Only available for timeline modes in HTML format. Set to 'yes' to enable interactive zooming of the timeline. Set to 'no' or omit to disable. Valid values: 'yes', 'no'.

query_syntax.description: The GDELT DOC 2.0 API supports a complex query language within the 'query' parameter, allowing for boolean logic, field-specific filters, proximity searches, and more.

operators.name: Boolean OR
operators.description: Allows searching for multiple terms with OR logic

operators.name: Exclusion
operators.description: Excludes results matching the specified term
operators.constraints: Must be placed at the beginning of the term

operators.name: Domain
operators.description: Returns all coverage from the specified domain

operators.name: DomainIs
operators.description: Returns all coverage from the specified domain with exact match

operators.name: ImageFaceTone
operators.description: Searches the average 'tone' of human facial emotions in each image

operators.name: ImageNumFaces
operators.description: Searches the total number of foreground human faces in the image

operators.name: ImageOCRMeta
operators.description: Searches a combination of OCR results, image metadata, and captions

operators.name: ImageTag
operators.description: Searches topical tags assigned by Google's algorithms

operators.name: ImageWebCount
operators.description: Searches for images that have appeared a certain number of times on the web

operators.name: ImageWebTag
operators.description: Searches for topics used to describe the image across the web

operators.name: Near
operators.description: Specifies that keywords must appear within a given number of words of each other
operators.constraints: Phrase matching not supported; only single words allowed

operators.name: Repeat
operators.description: Specifies that a word must appear at least a certain number of times
operators.constraints: Only a single word is permitted

operators.name: SourceCountry
operators.description: Searches for articles published in outlets located in a particular country
operators.constraints: For countries with spaces in names, use full name without spaces

operators.name: SourceLang
operators.description: Searches for articles originally published in the given language

operators.name: Theme
operators.description: Searches for GDELT Global Knowledge Graph Themes

operators.name: Tone
operators.description: Filters for articles above or below a particular tone score

operators.name: ToneAbs
operators.description: Filters for high emotion or low emotion articles, regardless of positive/negative

examples.natural_language: Show me the volume timeline of coverage mentioning 'islamic state' over the last 3 months
Show me a collage of images captioned 'donald trump' over the last 3 months
Show me the top 100 articles mentioning 'wildlife crime' or 'poaching' published in the last week
examples.query_value: query=("wildlife crime" OR poaching OR "illegal fishing" OR "wildlife trade")&mode=artlist&maxrecords=100&timespan=1week

quirks_and_warnings: Searches a rolling window of the last 3 months of coverage (not just 24 hours)
Supports searching across 65 languages using English keywords (machine translated)
Default max results is 75, can be increased to 250 using maxrecords parameter
Image search modes have specific limitations (e.g., ImageCollageInfo mode provides additional image metadata)
The API uses machine translation for all non-English content
